precise_scope: Enel 2019 green use-of-proceeds issue only; annual financial-table vintages 2019–2024.
exact_claim: The selected issue retains a reported allocation total of approximately EUR 986 million across all six report vintages.
available_evidence: All six financial tables print EUR 986 million. The original 2019 summary reports EUR 985.6 million; rounded project rows sum to EUR 986 million through 2022 and EUR 985 million in 2023–2024.
source_locators: Green reports 2019–2023 PDF p. 13; 2024 PDF p. 7; 2019 summary PDF p. 6.
inference_limit: Supports approximate reported-stock continuity. It does not establish exact cash continuity, annual financing flow or identical composition.

precise_scope: Enel 2019 issue; 2022-to-2023 reported allocation change only.
exact_claim: Project-line monetary allocations are unchanged between the 2022 and 2023 vintages.
available_evidence: The source discloses EUR 156.86 million reassigned: EUR 30.93 million and EUR 125.93 million removed from Cohuna and Kafireas; EUR 55.38 million and EUR 101.48 million assigned to Alta Farms II and Seven Cowboy.
source_locators: 2023 Green Bond Report PDF p. 4 reassignment note and p. 13 financial table; 2022 PDF p. 13.
inference_limit: The approximately 15.9% reassigned share uses only the declared EUR 985.6 million original 2019 allocation-stock denominator (156.86 / 985.6). EUR 986 million is a rounded reported total, not an interchangeable precise denominator. This is not a measure of physical output or new spending.

exact_claim: The Cohuna/Kafireas allocation exits follow deconsolidation after subsidiary-level stake sales while Enel retains joint control and economic interests.
available_evidence: Australia: 50% of two parent entities sold to INPEX on 29 September 2023; joint control retained. Cohuna vehicles show 50% Group holding at year-end. Hellas: 50% sold on 29 December 2023 with joint control retained; an official release links Kafireas to Hellas. The green report explicitly connects deconsolidation to EUR 156.86 million of 2019-issue reassignment.
source_locators: 2023 Green Bond Report p. 4; Annual Report 2023 pp. 235, 237 and 483; Kafireas issuer release 15 October 2019, opening paragraph.
inference_limit: The 50% sales concern Australian parent entities and Hellas, not verified direct 50% plant sales. Continued joint control is at subsidiary/JV level. Allocation-pool removal does not establish physical retirement or complete economic exit; Kafireas’s exact plant-level stake is not inferred.

precise_scope: Enel November 2018 green-bond framework examined for the selected UoP issue.
exact_claim: The examined framework separates corporate decarbonization ambitions from eligible use-of-proceeds and reallocation provisions.
available_evidence: The November 2018 framework discusses corporate decarbonization on PDF pp. 1–2 and use-of-proceeds/reallocation on pp. 4 and 6. No named bond-linked fossil-exit obligation was identified in those examined provisions.
inference_limit: This is a finding limited to the examined provisions, not universal absence of a commitment. Corporate ambition and eligibility provisions do not establish a named fossil-exit obligation or its breach.

precise_scope: Iberdrola International February 2019 hybrid, ISIN XS1890845875; 2019–2024 report vintages.
exact_claim: The matched hybrid reports an EUR 800 million allocation stock in every 2019–2024 vintage.
available_evidence: Six observations report EUR 800 million, with recurring attributed capacity of 231 MW.
inference_limit: Six repeated stocks do not equal EUR 4.8 billion of new financing; instrument-level constancy does not establish unchanged project weights.

precise_scope: Iberdrola International February 2019 hybrid, ISIN XS1890845875; 2019–2024 report vintages.
exact_claim: The monetary weights of East Anglia ONE and Wikinger are unchanged across the six vintages.
available_evidence: The selected reports disclose EUR 800 million only at instrument level. All project-money fields remain blank; attributable MW do not identify monetary shares.
inference_limit: Unknown weights are not evidence of changed weights. Neither stable names nor 180/51 MW permits proportional money imputation or a monetary-overlap estimate.

precise_scope: Second-party opinion for the selected February 2019 hybrid.

available_evidence: The 4 February 2019 opinion identifies East Anglia ONE and Wikinger, an anticipated 25% refinancing share, full allocation expected within 12 months, and substitution following divestment. No named bond-linked fossil-exit condition was identified in the examined provisions.
source_locators: IB-SPO19: PDF/printed pp1–2,5–7,10 | IB-GR19: selected bond: printed19/PDF20; separate March 2018 issue: printed16/PDF17 footnote13
inference_limit: The 25% share is a pre-issuance expectation, not a verified realized split or additionality estimate. The archived standalone framework date remains unverified. Absence of a named exit condition is bounded to the inspected provisions; wider commitments are not denied.

precise_scope: SSE GB5, ISIN XS2510903862; three generating projects in the 2023 and 2024 reports. GB6 excluded from continuity totals.
exact_claim: GB5 project monetary allocations are unchanged between the two observed reports.
available_evidence: All three allocations remain GBP 166 million, GBP 37.2 million and GBP 340.7 million. The disclosed monetary overlap is GBP 543.9 million, or 100% of the prior disclosed stock.
source_locators: Green-bond reports 2023 and 2024 Table 6, printed p. 9 (2024 PDF p. 10); 2024 Table 1 for settlement.
inference_limit: Supports monetary continuity only at reported precision across 2023–2024. It does not establish unchanged underlying expenditure invoices, cash or earlier allocation history.

precise_scope: Three GB5 projects; actual operation events 2021–2024 relative to August 2022 settlement.
exact_claim: The three financed projects reach full operation at different dates, despite shared refinancing classification.
available_evidence: Gordonbush is fully operational in August 2021; Seagreen full operation is announced 17 October 2023; Viking full operation is announced 29 August 2024. GB5 settles 1 August 2022.
source_locators: 2024 green report Table 6; dated SSE milestones; TotalEnergies 17 October 2023 Seagreen announcement.
inference_limit: Physical new build and financial refinancing are separate axes. Announcement dates are preserved; Gordonbush exact operational day and Viking’s 443/434 MW discrepancy remain unresolved.

precise_scope: SSE 2021 framework and July 2022 GB5 second-party opinion; actual GB5 allocation cohort.

source_locators: SS-FW21: PDF/printed pp2–4,7,9–10 | SS-SPO22: PDF pp1–4,12–13 | SS-CR24: printed pp2–4 / PDF pp3–5

precise_scope: Gordonbush Extension only; GB5 report-to-31-March-2023 and report-to-31-March-2024 snapshots.
exact_claim: Gordonbush Extension retains both its reported GB5 allocation and full-operational status at the 2023 and 2024 snapshots.
available_evidence: Gordonbush shows GBP 37.2 million GB5 allocation in both reports and operational status at both 31 March snapshots; full operation is recorded as August 2021.
source_locators: Green-bond reports 2023 and 2024 Table 6, printed p. 9 (2024 PDF p. 10); 2024 Table 1 for settlement.
inference_limit: This is positive consistency within the selected records, not independent or out-of-sample validation. It supports endpoint amount and maturity continuity only; complete ownership continuity and within-year stability remain unidentified.
